english.title: Dangerous / careless cyclist failing to give name / address
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the rider of a cycle who was alleged to have committed an offence under section

(A)_[28]_
(B)_[29]_

of the Road Traffic Act 1988, refused, on being so required by a person having reasonable grounds for so requiring, to give your

(C)_[name]_
(D)_[address]_
(E)_[name and address]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 168 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
